description: Image Description: The image features a plush toy bear dressed in traditional Chinese attire, prominently displayed among other stuffed animals. The bear is primarily red with intricate golden patterns resembling classic Chinese designs, including swirling motifs and possibly auspicious symbols. On its forehead, there is a large golden Chinese character "福" (fú), which means "fortune" or "good luck," commonly used during festive occasions like Chinese New Year.
